notes.note: Re-recorded on the combined chat phone-fixes branch, which merges three already-reviewed branches (pane layout, tool rows and approvals, send and attachments) with origin/main. The sources that differ from the merged record (src-ui/src/index.css) carry those branches' changes: the pane-failure card, phone safe-area and table layout, stored conversation titles, and the transcript staying in place after a turn; ACP tool kinds and reported tool names, the single approval card and its grant label, the floating status pill, held inbox chips and the answered-request state; the attachment refusal code and staged-binding release, the composer image-support caveat, steer turn splitting, the model-picker unlock for a chat that never ran a turn, and the short-dock composer reservation. Each document or capture was reviewed against its branch's changes before the combination (notes files recorded on those branches, carried into this one). The combination itself changed source in three places, none of which alters a claim here: active-chats-state.ts and approvalHandlers.ts keep both main's pendingApprovalTurnIds and this work's answeredApprovals, and acp-adapter.ts publishes the request's tool kind once, from the ACP vocabulary. Every other source file merged without conflict.
